description: This is a shell script designed for automating dependency checking and testing of OpenWrt packages. It includes functions for making packages, cleaning build directories, checking stamps, and handling command-line options to control its behavior.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: deptest_make
methods.description: Runs the make command for a target, directing output to a log file.

methods.name: clean_kernel_build_dir
methods.description: Cleans the kernel build directory except for the kernel source directories.

methods.name: stamp_exists
methods.description: Checks if a stamp file exists or is a symbolic link.

methods.name: test_package
methods.description: Tests a specific package by checking dependencies, stamps, and building it if necessary.

methods.name: bootstrap_deptest_make
methods.description: Bootstraps dependencies for testing by running make targets with logs.

methods.name: bootstrap_native_make
methods.description: Runs native make targets with logging for bootstrapping.
